prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1038; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn in League City, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had been waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic and believed the path was clear when the impact happened. The collision threw me against the driver's side door, and I felt a sharp pain in my knee right away. I stayed at the scene until the police arrived and gave them my statement. When I later recalled the event, I added a few small details, such as the exact position of the signal light, but the core of my account never changed. I am the policyholder named on this policy, and I am filing this claim for damage to my vehicle and for the knee injury I sustained.
